title: He survived Hiroshima, returned home to Nagasaki and was hit by a second atomic bomb three days later: The story of Tsutomu Yamaguchi
summary_full: Tsutomu Yamaguchi, a survivor of both atomic bombings, faced immense physical and emotional trauma from his experiences. Initially reluctant to share his story, he eventually became an advocate for a world free of nuclear weapons. His journey from hibakusha to spokesperson illustrates the lasting impact of nuclear warfare on individuals and communities.
